from runpy import run_path
clamp = run_path('clamp.py')['clamp']
cases = [(-20, -10, -2, -10), (-10, -10, -2, -10), (-7, -10, -2, -7), (-2, -10, -2, -2), (8, -10, -2, -2), (-4, -3, 9, -3), (0, -3, 9, 0), (4, -3, 9, 4), (9, -3, 9, 9), (10, -3, 9, 9), (-0.75, -0.5, 0.5, -0.5), (0.125, -0.5, 0.5, 0.125), (0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5), (0.75, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5), (-9, 2, 2, 2), (2, 2, 2, 2), (12, 2, 2, 2)]
for value, lower, upper, expected in cases:
    actual = clamp(value, lower, upper)
    assert actual == expected, ((value, lower, upper), expected, actual)
print('Independent inclusive cases passed')
